verdict.rationale: Cline documents visual diff review inside VS Code/JetBrains (desktop IDE editors) and supports running many agents in parallel, but the parallel-session feature is a web-based task board, not a native desktop app for side-by-side session management as the story implies. missing for 10: a true standalone desktop app UI, direct evidence of side-by-side session viewing within one desktop window, independent hands-on confirmation of the task-board's parallel-session UX.
